8.3.7.14 Dem_SetCycleQualified
[SWS_Dem_91001] Definition of API function Dem_SetCycleQualified ⌈
Service Name
Dem_SetCycleQualified
Syntax
Std_ReturnType Dem_SetCycleQualified (
uint8 OperationCycleId
)
Service ID [hex]
0x56
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
Parameters (in)
OperationCycleId
Identification of a configured DemOperationCycle
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
Always E_OK is returned.
Description
Sets a dependent operation cycle as qualified, so it may be processed along with its leading
cycle.
Available via
Dem.h
⌋
